text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is the Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Winner(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
OlympicGames(olympic) ∧ SportingEvent(olympic) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
Location(olympic, tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Winner(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
